clarifications.MSG_VALIDATE: JSON Schema parameter/result validation only; TLS handshake/cert CPU is MSG_TRANSPORT_CPU with provenance transport_tls_handshake.
clarifications.MSG_DISPATCH: Frozen booking paths: server method lookup (measured); client_result_dispatch; client_call_inter_region_gaps (untimed CPU inside the client call boundary). Gaps dominate client DISPATCH in v8 raw throttle (~99.5–99.8%); v9 splits gaps into gap_decomposition mechanisms. TurnTrace echo is diffuseness of gaps, not method-dispatch dominance.
clarifications.MSG_TRANSPORT_CPU: Pipe/socket syscall CPU and TLS handshake/crypto path. HTTP/SSE primary transport is connection-per-message (Connection: close); transport_tls_handshake is a per-call handshake tax of that pattern, not reused-session record encryption. v10 named subslices: transport_connect, transport_tls_handshake, transport_write, transport_read, transport_syscall_return (generic transport_syscall remains a fallback). Post-return close/wrap is booked under transport_syscall_return when instrumented (leaves the gap).
clarifications.http_sse_connection: One TCP(/TLS) connection per measured exchange; handshake belongs in per-message TRANSPORT until a reuse arm exists.
clarifications.g6_provenance_coverage: Any steady category exceeding g6_dominant_category_share of booked steady CPU must have non-generic named provenance covering at least g6_named_provenance_share of that category, or G6 fails as presumptive opaque/gap-fill lump. The 95% single-category detector (g6_single_category_share) FAILs only when the dominant category is opaque or gap-fill-dominated (named direct-work share < g6_named_provenance_share after excluding g6_gap_fill_provenance); a concentration of directly-timed ops (e.g. transport_read) is physics, not an attribution lump. Gap-fill labels (client_call_inter_region_gaps, harness_sdk_uncovered_interior) never satisfy the exemption — that is the DISPATCH pattern recurring one level down. v10.1 amendment after pre-launch re-smoke; Axis 5 read-path fix confirmed concentration persists at theoretical-min syscalls.
clarifications.g7_gap_split_conservation: When message_diagnostics[message_id].gap_decomposition is present, Σ(mechanisms) must equal parent_cpu_ns within G3 conservation slack (max(conservation_floor_ns, conservation_fraction * parent)). Silent create/destroy of time in a v9 split fails G7. gap_unattributed is mandatory.
clarifications.diffuseness_verdict: Working definition (eight words): cost smeared between named instrumented regions. v1.5: confirm/refute evaluate over named mechanisms (a)–(d) only. gap_unattributed above unattributed_forces_inconclusive_share (default 0.20, same as headline e% bound) forces inconclusive — residual is unmeasured, not a fixable concentrated mechanism. Confirmed: no named mechanism exceeds confirm_max_single_mechanism_share, contributing named mechanisms >= confirm_min_mechanisms spanning >= confirm_min_boundaries, and (e) within bound. Refuted: one named mechanism exceeds refute_single_mechanism_share.
clarifications.verdict_min_population: Binding audit.diffuseness_verdict requires >= min_measured_messages per cell and >= min_seeds in the aggregate. Below the floor the classifier emits deferred_insufficient_population and logs advisory_only only. WSL seed-0 smoke cannot return a binding verdict.
clarifications.verdict_per_arm: Diffuseness verdicts are scoped per implementation arm. SDK answers the TurnTrace-echo (async framework) question; raw_jsonrpc is synchronous (gap_event_loop unmeasured) and answers whether a lean sync path still carries smeared residue. Do not pool arms into one verdict.
clarifications.gap_split_precedence: Overlap carve order for raw mechanism claims: gap_instrumentation then gap_gc then gap_event_loop then gap_syscall_return; remainder is gap_unattributed. Only gap_unattributed is a residual.
clarifications.gap_syscall_return_subprovenance: gap_syscall_return splits into gap_syscall_return_measured (named post-return sites still inside the gap) and gap_syscall_return_adjacent (transport-adjacent inter-region intervals). Adjacent-dominated (d) is presumptive gap-fill wearing a mechanism name until measured sites cover it.
clarifications.gap_gc_scope: gap_gc captures CPython cyclic collector via gc.callbacks only; refcount-driven deallocation is unmeasured and folds into gap_unattributed, never silently into gap_gc.
clarifications.observer_instrumentation_crosscheck: Per matched stripped/throttle pair, booked gap_instrumentation must not exceed throttle_combined - stripped_combined within G3 slack; else OBSERVER_ATTRIBUTION_SUSPECT. Negative brackets are unusable for the check.
clarifications.sub_millisecond_timing: Absolute half-width 5 µs (5000 ns) frozen before authenticity Axis 1 and v10 TRANSPORT sub-provenance measurement. Half-width = max(0.15*median, 5000 ns, max within-condition IQR). Idle Axis 1 uses cpu/wall < 5% separately. Principle source: CAP-01 died-ledger #5.

nested_depth_4.shape: four nested objects with five required scalar leaves each

pathological_large.shape: four nested objects with sixty-four required scalar leaves each

streamable_http.admission: all integration smoke gates pass with pinned stable SDK

authenticity_axis1_tool_body.notes: 5 µs absolute half-width for cross-condition / cross-mode tool-CPU comparisons on bare-metal Linux thread_time_ns. Idle-ratio gate (cpu/wall < 5%) remains separate and is not a relative median band. Do not compare single-digit-µs CPU medians with relative-only ±15%.

transport_sub_provenance_v10.notes: Same 5 µs floor when splitting TRANSPORT (connect/handshake/write/read/return) or comparing slices across transports. Relative ±15% still governs when the band median exceeds the floor.

near_zero_share_ratios.rule: When a category or mechanism median is below absolute_half_width_ns, treat share and IQR/median quotes as below_measurement_resolution; do not FAIL or headline on relative blow-ups of near-zero denominators without a ledgered absolute floor.
